# PixelFX source subset

Repository: https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx
Commit: fe7103c36d94e02f2d7df7d8f7a341e493837cde
Imported: 2026-10-31

Includes the renderer, PNG encoder and the dependency closure for impacts/hit-spark, nature/poison-cloud and arcane/portal. Retain LICENSE and NOTICE.md when distributing. No gallery fonts or gallery assets are included.

Source files are unchanged. Project palette/export settings live in Tools/ExportPixelFX.mjs and ArtSource/PixelFX/manifest.json. This subset is rendered with Node's standard library; no npm install or plugin installation is required.
